import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
arizona = ee.FeatureCollection("TIGER/2018/States").filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Arizona')).geometry()

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
# MODIS Aqua LST Day
def mask_lst(image):
    qa = image.select('QC_Day')
    # Bits 0-1: Mandatory QA flags (00 = good quality)
    quality_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
    return image.updateMask(quality_mask).select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)

# 2017 period
col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1').filterBounds(arizona).filterDate('2017-07-15', '2017-07-22').map(mask_lst)

print(f"2017 Images: {col_2017.size().getInfo()}")

if col_2017.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for 2017 period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 2001-2010 average for same period
years = ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010)

def get_july_mean(year):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 15)
    end = start.advance(7, 'day')
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1').filterBounds(arizona).filterDate(start, end).map(mask_lst)
    return col.mean().set('year', year)

col_historic = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(years.map(get_july_mean))

print(f"Historic yearly images: {col_historic.size().getInfo()}")

if col_historic.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for 2001-2010 period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing
img_2017 = col_2017.mean()
img_historic = col_historic.mean()

# Check pixel counts
count_2017 = img_2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=arizona,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

count_historic = img_historic.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=arizona,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

print(f"2017 valid pixels: {count_2017}")
print(f"Historic valid pixels: {count_historic}")

if count_2017 == 0 or count_historic == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculation
temp_2017 = img_2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=arizona,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

temp_historic = img_historic.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=arizona,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"2017 Mean LST: {temp_2017:.2f} C")
print(f"2001-2010 Mean LST: {temp_historic:.2f} C")

if temp_2017 is None or temp_historic is None:
    print("Calculation failed (None result).")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif temp_2017 < -100 or temp_2017 > 100 or temp_historic < -100 or temp_historic > 100:
    print("Invalid temperature range.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif temp_2017 > temp_historic:
    print(f"Difference: +{temp_2017 - temp_historic:.2f} C")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Difference: {temp_2017 - temp_historic:.2f} C")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
